name: What penalties can I face if convicted of a misdemeanor in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: What penalties can I face if convicted of a misdemeanor in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: Penalties may include up to one year in county jail, probation, fines, community service, and mandatory classes, depending on the offense and circumstances.sandiegocounty+1​
